app.name: SizeFit
app.tagline: Hit the exact file size a form demands — without going one byte over.
home.privacyBody: Everything happens on this device. Your files are never uploaded, and location data is stripped from whatever you save.
target.title: What size do you need?
target.errorNeedMax: Enter a maximum size in KB
target.errorMinAboveMax: Minimum cannot be larger than maximum
target.pngHelp: PNG is lossless, so only the pixel size changes its file size. If your form sets a minimum, JPEG is the safer choice.
mode.keepHelp: Leaves the picture at its own size and changes only the file size.
mode.fitHelp: Scales the picture to sit inside this box without distorting it. The result may be smaller than the box on one side.
mode.exactHelp: Resizes to exactly this width and height, stretching if needed. Use it when the form insists on precise pixels.
preview.title: Result
preview.pngNoQuality: PNG is lossless — quality has no effect on its size.
preview.paddedNote: Padded by {size} to clear the minimum. The picture is unchanged — forms only measure the file.
preview.passthroughNote: Your file already met every requirement, so nothing was changed.
preview.overBody: This file is {size}, above the {limit} ceiling. The form will reject it. Lower the quality, or go back and allow a smaller size.
status.underLimitBelowMin: UNDER THE LIMIT, BELOW THE MINIMUM
status.overLimit: OVER THE LIMIT — DO NOT UPLOAD
settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyBody: SizeFit does all its work on your device. No account, no upload, no tracking of what you compress. Location and camera data are removed from every file it saves.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.corruptInput: That file could not be read. It may be damaged or in a format this device cannot open.
error.fileGone: That file is no longer available. Pick it again.
error.lowDisk: This device is very low on storage ({free} free). Free up some space before compressing, or the file may fail to save.
error.permissionDenied: SizeFit needs gallery access to save the file. You can grant it in Settings.
error.shareUnavailable: Sharing is not available on this device.
error.shareWeb: Sharing is only available in the mobile app. Use Save instead.
target.outputHelp: The size limit applies to each file separately.
target.outputPdfHelp: The size limit applies to the finished PDF, so each page gets a share of it.
batch.title: {count} files
batch.savedSome: Saved {saved} files. {failed} could not be saved.
batch.oneOver: 1 file is over the limit and will be rejected.
batch.someOver: {count} files are over the limit and will be rejected.
batch.pdfOver: The PDF is {size}, over the {limit} limit. Remove a page or allow a larger size.
home.recentsEmptyBody: The sizes you use will show up here so the next file takes two taps.
home.howStep1: Pick a photo or a PDF, or several photos at once.
home.howStep2: Tap the size your form asks for.
home.howStep3: Save the file — never over the limit.
target.sliderHelpNoMin: Drag the left handle in if your form also sets a smallest size — some reject a file for being too small.
target.sliderHelpRange: The file will land between these two. Drag the left handle fully left if there is no smallest size.
target.capNote: Your file is {size}. A limit above that would need no compression.
document.title: Document
document.skipped: {count} image(s) in this PDF could not be recompressed, so they are unchanged. The pages still look the same.
document.noImages: This PDF is text or line art, not scanned pictures, so there is nothing to compress. It is already as small as this app can make it.
document.cannotReach: This document could not be brought under {size} without making the pages unreadable. Choose a larger size, or compress fewer pages at a time.
target.documentNote: Pixel size and format do not apply to a PDF — only the file size does.
error.encryptedPdf: That PDF is password-protected, so it cannot be opened here. Remove the password in your PDF reader and try again.
preview.pngSteerOver: PNG is lossless — it has no quality setting to turn down, so it cannot be squeezed under {limit}. JPEG can reach it.
preview.pngSteerUnder: PNG is lossless, so its size cannot be tuned to land above {min}. JPEG can be adjusted to sit inside the range.
preview.pngSteerFlatten: Any transparent areas will be filled with a solid colour.
mode.fillHelp: Gives you exactly this width and height without distorting the picture, by trimming whatever does not fit. This is what the pixel sizes above use.
